segments.name: EMEA
products: audio and other hardware accessory products
segments.description: Sells education technology products and services in Europe, Middle East and Africa, mainly through the Sahara Entities.
segments.evidence: Our EMEA segment consists of the operations of Sahara Holding Limited and its subsidiaries (the "Sahara Entities").

segments.name: Americas
products: audio and other hardware accessory products
segments.description: Sells education technology products and services across North and Central America, mainly through Boxlight, Inc. and its subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: Our Americas segment consists primarily of Boxlight, Inc. and its subsidiaries and the Rest of World segment consists primarily of Boxlight Australia, PTY LTD ("Boxlight Australia").

segments.name: Rest of World
products: audio and other hardware accessory products
segments.description: Sells education technology products and services in all other geographic regions, mainly through Boxlight Australia.
segments.evidence: The Company's operations are organized, managed, and classified into three reportable segments – Europe, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"), North and Central America (the "Americas"), and all other geographic regions ("Rest of World").

revenueModel.text: Education customers pay for interactive displays and related software, which generated the majority of revenue to date.
revenueModel.evidence: To date, we have generated the majority of our revenue in the U.S. and internationally from the sale of interactive displays and related software to the educational market.
